messages:
Sam: Need a Hosted API key for Acme POC. Requirements: scoped to generation, IP allowlist, 48h TTL, KMS-backed audit logs, and automated rotation. Can someone own provisioning?
Priya: I can. Please confirm CIDR(s) and whether embeddings are needed later. Our default for POCs is 24h TTL but can do 48h if sales requests it.
Sam: CIDR is 203.0.113.32/28. No embeddings now. Sales wants a single-key handoff to the AE and a rotation script they can run.
security-bot: Security checklist reminder: POC keys must be scoped, TTL <= 48h, IP allowlist enforced, KMS audit enabled, console access disabled. Set anomaly alert at >2x baseline.
Priya: Plan: create key `acme_poc_gen_2026`, scope=generate-only, ttl_seconds=172800, ip_allowlist=["203.0.113.32/28"], model_whitelist=["gpt-4-lite"], soft quota=50k tokens/day, throttle=15rps. Internal create example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/v1/keys \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"customer":"acme","scope":"generation","ttl_seconds":172800,"ip_allowlist":["203.0.113.32/28"],"models":["gpt-4-lite"]}'
```
Priya: Rotation pattern: daily rotate job (03:00 UTC) calls internal rotate endpoint, validates new key with a smoke generate call, then revokes old key. Rotate example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/v1/keys/rotate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"key_id":"acme_poc_gen_2026","revoke_old":true}'
```
ops-bot: Provision request accepted. Creating key...
ops-bot: Key created: acme_poc_gen_2026 (expires 2462033955). Secret posted to #secure-handoff. Audit logging (KMS) enabled.
Maya: I'll add a one-page README to the handoff with: sample generate call, allowed models, TTL, rotation steps, and how to request an extension. Also DM AE with the secret link.
Sam: Can we include a rotation script the AE can run manually if they want to rotate before TTL?
Priya: Yes. We'll include a small bash script that calls the rotate endpoint and prints the new secret URL. We'll also note that rotate will revoke the old secret immediately after validation.
security-bot: Note: set audit retention to 90d for the POC. If customer requests longer retention, escalate to compliance.
Sam: Thanks all — AE will validate within the hour. Closing after they confirm successful generate. :white_check_mark:
